source_note: FOMC lowered the federal funds target range to 0 to 1/4 percent. First full month under the new stance is 2009-01.
FOMC raised the federal funds target range to 1/4 to 1/2 percent. First full month under the new stance is 2016-01.
FOMC lowered the federal funds target range to 0 to 1/4 percent during the COVID-19 shock. First full month under the new stance is 2020-04.
FOMC raised the federal funds target range to 1/4 to 1/2 percent and began the inflation-driven tightening cycle. First full month under the new stance is 2022-04.
FOMC lowered the federal funds target range to 4-3/4 to 5 percent in the first reduction after the tightening cycle. First full month under the new stance is 2024-10.
NBER business-cycle dates are secondary reference points only and are not used to choose monetary-regime boundaries.
